item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Today’s high temperatures reach from the low forties to the mid forties, with cloudy to mostly cloudy skies and a chance of rain or snow showers early, especially this morning, but any precipitation will be light and scattered. Tonight, expect lows ranging from the upper twenties to the low thirties under mostly cloudy to cloudy skies, with only a slight chance of lingering precipitation. Across the region, no significant new snow or rainfall is expected, and skies remain mostly cloudy through the night.
